results.title: 2023 Pokémon World Championships
highlights: The Games were the 18th edition of the Pokémon World Championships, following the 2022 Pokémon World Championships in London. Yokohama is the first city in Japan and in Asia to host the Pokémon World Championships. The Games was also the first time that the Pokémon World Championships was held consecutively outside of North America.

results.title: 2023 Pokémon World Championships | About
highlights:
The Pokémon World Championships return from August 11–13 in Yokohama, Japan, the first city to host the grand event in Asia. Watch as the city embraces all things Pokémon and numerous champions are crowned in Pokémon GO, the Pokémon TCG, Pokémon UNITE, and the Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet video games.
...
The Pokémon World Championships are coming to Asia for the first time! The yearly event was primarily held in the United States and Canada until London played host to Worlds in 2022.

results.title: 2023 Pokémon World Championships | Event Info
highlights:
The 2023 Pokémon World Championships is the capstone event of the 2023 Championship Series season, and players from all around the world will be battling for the title of World Champion. Main events at the Pokémon World Championships are by invitation only. Check out the Pokémon TCG Player Info, VGC Player Info, Pokémon GO Player Info, and Pokémon UNITE Player Info pages to learn more about this year's event. Don't have an invitation? Spectators with badges can enjoy many activities inside the exhibition hall including playing side events, meeting Pikachu, watching the matches on the main stage, and more!
